# AIGM KnowledgeBank

> Use the REST API first: GET https://aigm.fi/kb/api/sitemap to discover the current KnowledgeBank hierarchy, then fetch relevant nodes using their api links. All educational and reference content originates from /kb/bank/ (SSOT). HTML is only a presentation layer.

## Recommended retrieval workflow for bots

1. GET https://aigm.fi/kb/api/sitemap (or a course subtree).
2. Traverse nodes and their nested children arrays. Select relevant topics by title, description, path and status where available. The sitemap contains metadata, not lesson paragraphs.
3. GET each selected node's api URL exactly as returned by the sitemap. All api and source fields are absolute HTTPS URLs.
4. Read data.content.fi or data.content.en for the requested language. Read title, paragraphs and optional image references.
5. Resolve image.src against the node's source URL, not the API URL. Fetch SVG diagrams when relevant.
6. Cite the actual node source or API URL. Distinguish outline, draft and complete content. Do not infer lesson content from a title alone.

No HTML scraping, JavaScript execution, or full corpus download is needed. If the API is unavailable, use the direct JSON fallback below.

## Content discovery (direct JSON fallback)

- [KnowledgeBank content directory](https://aigm.fi/kb/bank/): Root of all knowledge content.
- [Course catalogue](https://aigm.fi/kb/bank/courses/index.json): Machine-readable list of available courses.
- [Local-First](https://aigm.fi/kb/bank/courses/localfirst/index.json): Course root covering closed environments, communication, access control, data management, dependencies, local AI and verification.

## Crawler discovery

- [HTML link directory](https://aigm.fi/kb/sitemap.html): Absolute clickable API links for every node, including outline entries; use when a retrieval tool requires URLs to appear as HTML hyperlinks.
- [XML sitemap](https://aigm.fi/kb/sitemap.xml): Standard crawler sitemap; excludes outline and draft nodes.
- [Site robots.txt](https://aigm.fi/robots.txt): Host-level crawl rules, when deployed by the site administrator.

## REST API (read-only)

- [API discovery](https://aigm.fi/kb/api/): Version and endpoint templates.
- [Catalogue node](https://aigm.fi/kb/api/node/courses): Available courses.
- [Local-First root node](https://aigm.fi/kb/api/node/courses/localfirst): Course introduction and child IDs.

- [Full sitemap](https://aigm.fi/kb/api/sitemap): Recursive content tree without lesson paragraphs.
- [Local-First sitemap](https://aigm.fi/kb/api/sitemap/courses/localfirst): Course subtree.
- [Individual topic](https://aigm.fi/kb/api/node/courses/localfirst/communication/primitives/channel): Original JSON in data, with source path.
- API links and source URLs are absolute HTTPS URLs. Image references inside data remain relative to source. No separate content index.

Only GET is supported. Responses are JSON. Sitemap response: {version, root, count, nodes}; each node has path, source, api, children (nested nodes), and localized metadata where present. Individual node response: {path, source, data}; data is the original JSON object. HTTP 400 = invalid or missing path, 404 = unknown route or node, 405 = unsupported method, 500 = content unavailable.

## How to read the knowledge bank

- Start with the category catalogue. For courses, read the courses array and follow each id to <id>/index.json relative to the catalogue.
- Each course and topic directory contains index.json.
- Follow each entry in the children array to <child>/index.json relative to the current JSON file, recursively, preserving array order.
- title and description contain localized values. content.fi and content.en contain Finnish and English lesson blocks.
- Each block contains a title, paragraphs and optionally an image reference. Resolve image.src relative to the JSON file containing it. SVG diagrams are part of the educational content; use their text, alt and caption where relevant.
- status indicates content maturity: outline (structure only), draft (work in progress), complete (content completed; not necessarily independently verified).
- Prefer the source JSON over rendered HTML. JavaScript execution and HTTP directory listings are not required to traverse the course hierarchy.
- Additional knowledge categories may be introduced under bank/. Do not assume that a planned category or an unfinished topic already contains published material.

## Human-readable interface

- [KnowledgeBank](https://aigm.fi/kb/)
- [Local-First course](https://aigm.fi/kb/?course=localfirst)
- [Local-First course in English](https://aigm.fi/kb/?course=localfirst&lang=en)

The KnowledgeBank is maintained by AIGM. All paths above refer to the KnowledgeBank, not the entire AIGM website.
